subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellDriver1: Remove unused Status
reasons: Removes an unused EFI_STATUS variable in two specific functions; the return values of two specific calls are intentionally ignored
While 'remove unused variable' is a general pattern, the fix is narrow: only two instances where Status was set but the return value was already being disregarded by design
Coccinelle could match this pattern generically, but it would produce false positives; each instance needs reasoning about whether the return value matters
